notes: Data renders correctly on CARTO dark-matter basemap with exact initial view; major (red) and mid (amber) points clearly distinct, legend and tooltip (name + abbrev) implemented via getTooltip.

Uses dated deck.gl 8.9.35 dist.min.js with `new deck.DeckGL({mapLib, mapStyle})` standalone pattern instead of v9 MapboxOverlay/addControl; harmless blocked request for mapbox-gl.css from the v8 bundle.
